confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are triangulated from several aggregated Philippines cost-of-living sources, which are national or general averages rather than Coron-specific, with an uplift for a tourist island town. Beer is partly grounded in the same sources. Cocktail and wine have no Coron price data; cocktail is set at about 2.5 times the beer anchor and wine at a restaurant markup over beer, a relationship-based estimate. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not checked against live listings. The FX observation (15 Oct 2026, 4pm) was taken from an RBA search summary that I could not confirm on the page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Philippines island tourist destinations with restaurant and bar pricing similar to El Nido and Puerto Princesa, adjusted upward from national averages for tourist-area pricing. Accommodation is a general SEA island-town estimate.
